d: Long, dark ash-grey hair is styled into two high twin-tails with straight-cut bangs and a soft texture. The golden-amber eyes are wide and determined, set in a youthful face with the maturity of a teenager. A slender build is dressed in a white short-sleeved top, a red pleated skirt, and dark grey armored plating on the shoulders and forearms, complemented by a dark grey chest piece and a red overskirt. Signature details include two small white ribbons tied at the hair roots, brown fingerless gloves, and a large mechanical aircraft-themed rigging assembly featuring a dark green plane and a red-and-gold flight deck.
